name: High Mountain Goat
body:
These goats are known for being sure-footed climbers, scaling vertical peaks that would give a monkey pause.

Requirements: Ram mount.

Climber: High mountain goats gain a +2 trait bonus on Climb checks, and Climb is a class skill for them.
